purpose: Native production benchmark complete-update timing, exact parity, admission/lifetime and final-source qualification for optional frozen-decoder BF16 shadows.
parity_comparator_pin_scope: The preserved campaign compare.py is pinned at evidence generation. Existing parity reports do not embed an execution-time comparator digest; this summary does not rerun tensor comparisons.

inputs.hash_verification_scope: Pins recorded by benchmark admission; no large artifact rehash in summarizer.

reference.timing_contract: Outer CUDA synchronization; compiler reset, collection, native reward, replay, clipping and optimizer included. Separate phase/profiler steps are excluded from measured samples.
reference.cold_step_definition: First step of this fresh process; disk compiler caches were not necessarily empty.

candidate.timing_contract: Outer CUDA synchronization; compiler reset, collection, native reward, replay, clipping and optimizer included. Separate phase/profiler steps are excluded from measured samples.
candidate.cold_step_definition: First step of this fresh process; disk compiler caches were not necessarily empty.

frozen_decoder_staging.timing_contract: Persistent worker staging spans warmup, measured and diagnostic updates. Setup/cleanup excluded from native _step timings and reported separately; per-forward guards remain timed.

comparison.setup_amortization_scope: Recorded setup_seconds_per_update includes warmup plus measured updates in this fresh worker; it excludes checkpoint/validation/reexec costs.

exact_parity.scope: Existing zero-tolerance comparator report for all measured steps, recursively covering groups, clipped gradients, updated parameters and optimizer state. Large tensor receipts are not reloaded or rehashed here.

count_semantics.tensors: Every compared tensor, including floating, integer and boolean tensors; exact_tensors counts torch.equal successes.
count_semantics.scalars: Python floating scalars only; exact_scalars counts exact equality for these floats. This does not count every scalar or token.
count_semantics.uncounted_values: Token IDs and other integer, boolean, string and structural values are recursively checked, including dictionary keys and sequence lengths, without contributing to the floating-scalar count.

gpu_ownership.sample_storage: Each process row appears once. Region sample_indices index the shared samples array.
limitations: The monitor may continue; this receipt hashes a complete-line prefix, not the eventual whole CSV.
Approximately 1Hz polling cannot rule out subsecond compute processes, graphics activity, or CPU contention.
CSV process rows are not an independent heartbeat; gaps outside CUDA residency need not indicate competing work.
CSV local clock uses the launch receipt's timezone offset. Log-derived boundaries are conservative at second resolution.
Only the four completed benchmark process windows are retained; qualification and later profiles are excluded.

cpu.source_scope: CPU checks preceded the immutable source pin; their logs/JUnit are retained without claiming execution-time manifests equivalent to the final-source CUDA snapshots.
cpu.initial_failure_scope: Four Gloo socket-permission failures were rerun outside the sandbox; exact failed test IDs all pass in the preserved rerun.

qualification.scope: Single RTX 4090 CUDA adapter contracts, scripted-token/mixed-reward depth-2 nonzero-gradient updates, and real-tokenizer trainer reexec/fork/uninterrupted equivalence. CLI restart does not require nonzero native reward. No Hopper or multi-GPU staging qualification.

historical_prototype_screening.scope: Historical ignored-prototype screening. These are separate from primary production-code timing and qualification.

limits: One fresh process per arm per workload; no confidence interval, randomized multi-run campaign, or reference/reference noise estimate.
Complete-update times exclude staging, cleanup, checkpoint loading/reexec, validation and telemetry; staging setup and per-worker amortization are reported separately.
Optional staging uses extra persistent GPU memory; admission estimates available memory and does not guarantee later allocation success.
Scalar JSON receipts and existing exact-parity reports are checked; large checkpoint and tensor receipt contents are not reloaded or rehashed here.

Runtime source identities are compared across all arms and bound to the requested commit; final-source CUDA snapshots record an unchanged clean core manifest. The current working tree is not used as a substitute for the recorded source.
